name: Bennett Industries Of Tennessee, Inc.
old_description: Bennett Industries is proud to offer multiple services within the Metal Worx realm. We focus but are not limited to custom fabrication, metal sales, small and large-scale productions, CNC cutting, precision machining, and stamping.
about:
Bennett Industries of Tennessee operates a 46,000-square-foot facility on a five-acre campus at 2299 Summerfield Road in Cookeville, Tennessee, just off Highway 111. The company has been serving the region for over fifty years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names have not been published.

The shop runs six integrated service lines — Metal Worx, Powder Worx, Fab Worx, Machine Worx, Blast Worx, and Awning Worx — covering metal sales, CNC cutting and precision machining, custom fabrication, welding, stamping, sandblasting, restoration, powder coating, and awning production. It handles both small- and large-scale production runs, with capabilities that span from raw material supply through finished assemblies. No headcount or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Customers include manufacturers, contractors, DIY enthusiasts, and the general public. The company positions itself as a single-source provider for industrial production and manufacturing needs across those segments.

Bennett Industries emphasizes its breadth of in-house capabilities, offering “services for most any manufacturing need” under one roof, from raw metal sales to final finishing and awning fabrication.
